2608.28363.title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
2608.28363.paper_summary: LLM agents increasingly modify their own prompts, tools, middleware, resources, and execution harnesses at runtime. Such self-evolution can improve capability, but a successful mutation may leave persistent effects that cannot be safely reversed in states different from the one in which it was created. We introduce EvoUndo, a framework for representing, synthesizing, diagnosing, and independently verifying recoverability of model-generated self-modifications across counterfactual states. Across 600 unseen one-shot self-evolution tasks, we identify 197 capability-improving mutations that fail recoverability verification. Under the original recovery representation, conventional repair strategies recover 0/197 of these natural failures. Deterministic oracle analysis recovers 48/197 under the original recovery language L0, while the extended recovery calculus increases empirical oracle recovery to 191/197. A protocol-locked 2x2 grounding-by-expressivity intervention then separates two bottlenecks: exact state-address grounding increases successful recovery from 0/48 to 38/48 (79.2%) when the original language is sufficient, while extending the recovery language enables recovery on 142/143 (99.3%) failures in the oracle-defined S1 stratum. On the primary gpt-oss-120b backbone, adding exact-address diagnostics to the richer language reduces recovery to 133/143 (93.0%); a Qwen3.8-27B replication preserves the grounding and expressivity effects but not this negative interaction, indicating that the latter is model-dependent. These results indicate that reliable agent self-evolution requires co-designing verification, state grounding, witness semantics, and recovery-language expressivity rather than relying on iterative prompting alone.
2608.28363.paper_summary_zh: LLM 代理人越來越多地在運行時修改自己的提示、工具、中介軟體、資源和執行環境。這種自我演化可以提高能力，但成功的變異可能會留下持久的影響，這些影響在不同於創建狀態的情況下無法安全地逆轉。我們介紹了 EvoUndo，一個用於表示、合成、診斷和獨立驗證模型生成的自我修改在反事實狀態下可恢復性的框架。在 600 個未見過的一次性自我演化任務中，我們識別出 197 個提高能力的變異，這些變異未能通過可恢復性驗證。在原始恢復表示下，傳統的修復策略對這些自然失敗的恢復率為 0/197。在原始恢復語言 L0 下，確定性神諭分析的恢復率為 48/197，而擴展的恢復演算將經驗神諭的恢復率提高到 191/197。一個協議鎖定的 2x2 表達性介入隨後分離了兩個瓶頸：當原始語言足夠時，精確狀態地址的基礎設施將成功恢復率從 0/48 提高到 38/48（79.2%），而擴展恢復語言則使得在神諭定義的 S1 層級上對 142/143（99.3%）失敗的恢復成為可能。在主要的 gpt-oss-120b 主幹上，將精確地址診斷添加到更豐富的語言中使恢復率降低到 133/143（93.0%）；一個 Qwen3.8-27B 的複製保留了基礎設施和表達性效果，但不包括這一負面交互，這表明後者是模型依賴的。這些結果表明，可靠的代理自我演化需要共同設計驗證、狀態基礎、見證語義和恢復語言的表達性，而不是單靠迭代提示。
